integrity: The focal kernel factorization was checked against the source, and the sharp constants were reconstructed independently from multiplier norms and spectral calculus. No independent audit or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact multiplier-norm step is proved only for \(\alpha\ge0\); no claim is made for \(-1<\alpha<0\), for the adjoint-symbol space \(\mathcal A_\alpha(B_A^*)\), or for global optimality among all nonrigid symbols.
title: Sharp norm distortion for a Möbius sub-Bergman model
